acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p stoa-mail -- x_stoa_auth; Email/get returns x-stoa-auth when capability present
description:
Expose DNS authentication evidence as a custom JMAP property x-stoa-auth
on Email/get responses, sourced from the dns_auth_cache table.

## Precedent

stoa already exposes x-stoa-cid, x-stoa-sig, and x-stoa-verifications
as custom properties on Email/get (crates/mail/src/jmap/backend_types.rs
and crates/mail/src/email/types.rs). x-stoa-auth follows the same pattern.

## Session capability

Add to the JMAP session capabilities (crates/mail/src/jmap/session.rs):
  'urn:stoa:jmap:auth' capability advertised
  Clients include it in 'using' to receive x-stoa-auth in responses.

## Property shape

x-stoa-auth is returned as a JSON object on each Email object:

```json
{
  "x-stoa-auth": {
    "dkim": "pass",           // "pass" | "fail" | "none"
    "dkim-domain": "example.com", // signing domain or ""
    "arc": "pass",            // "pass" | "fail" | "none"
    "spf": "softfail",        // "pass" | "fail" | "softfail" | "neutral" | "none"
    "dmarc": "pass",          // "pass" | "fail" | "none"
    "dmarc-policy": "quarantine" // "reject" | "quarantine" | "none"
  }
}
```

Absent field = "none" (auth check was not run or no record exists).
The object is always present when the capability is requested; never null.

## Lookup strategy

At Email/get time, for each email ID (CID):
1. Query dns_auth_cache WHERE record_cid is found via a join or
   secondary lookup: given the article CID, find the domain/selector
   combinations that were cached when that article was ingested.

Problem: dns_auth_cache is keyed by (evidence_type, domain, selector)
not by article CID. Need a bridge table:

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS article_auth_evidence (
    article_cid   TEXT NOT NULL,
    evidence_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    domain        TEXT NOT NULL,
    selector      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    result        TEXT NOT NULL,  -- 'pass'|'fail'|'softfail'|'neutral'|'none'
    policy        TEXT,           -- DMARC policy value if evidence_type='dmarc'
    PRIMARY KEY (article_cid, evidence_type, domain, selector)
);
```

This table is written by DnsAuthCache.cache_from_article() alongside
the dns_auth_cache row — it records the per-article result at ingest
time, not just the key material. Email/get reads from this table.

Note: this is a separate concern from dns_auth_cache (which stores
the key material for forensic re-verification). article_auth_evidence
stores the result of verification at ingest time.

## Migration

Add article_auth_evidence table to the same migration as dns_auth_cache
(update stoa-p4oc4.1) or add a new migration file immediately after.

## Implementation

Files:
- crates/mail/src/email/types.rs: add x_stoa_auth field to Email struct
- crates/mail/src/jmap/backend_types.rs: include x-stoa-auth in GetObject properties
- crates/mail/src/jmap/backend.rs (get_emails): query article_auth_evidence by CID,
  build AuthResult struct, serialize to x-stoa-auth JSON
- crates/mail/src/jmap/session.rs: add urn:stoa:jmap:auth to capabilities
- crates/transit/src/dns_auth_cache.rs: write to article_auth_evidence in
  cache_from_article() alongside dns_auth_cache writes

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize, Default)]
#[serde(rename_all = "kebab-case")]
pub struct XStoaAuth {
    pub dkim: String,           // "pass"|"fail"|"none"
    pub dkim_domain: String,
    pub arc: String,
    pub spf: String,
    pub dmarc: String,
    pub dmarc_policy: String,
}
```

Defensive rules:
- Missing rows in article_auth_evidence → all fields default to "none"
- DB errors → log warn, return all-none XStoaAuth (never propagate to client)
- Only returned when client includes urn:stoa:jmap:auth in 'using'

Tests:
- test_email_get_x_stoa_auth_pass: seed article_auth_evidence with dkim=pass,
  call Email/get, assert x-stoa-auth.dkim == "pass"
- test_email_get_x_stoa_auth_missing: no evidence rows → all fields "none"
- test_email_get_x_stoa_auth_not_returned_without_capability: x-stoa-auth absent
  when urn:stoa:jmap:auth not in using
title: JMAP: expose x-stoa-auth property on Email/get from dns_auth_cache
